[作物：苹果] [病害：苹果黑星病]  
果实和叶片上初现浅表性、天鹅绒状、暗橄榄色至黑色的斑点，为苹果黑星病的初期症状；果实上的病斑随病情发展逐渐木栓化、呈疮痂状，严重时导致组织畸形。
title: apple-scab
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: apple-scab]
Superficial, velvety dark-olive-to-black spots on fruits and leaves are the initial symptoms of apple scab. These fruit spots become scablike with age and tissues may become misshapen.
## Comments on the Disease

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：苹果黑星病]  
果实上的病斑随年龄增长逐渐变为疮痂状，组织可能变形。  
## 病害说明  
病菌以菌丝体在落地的病叶中越冬。春季降雨时释放初侵染孢子，在叶片和幼果表面持续湿润条件下侵染嫩叶和幼果；病斑上产生的分生孢子可进行再侵染。在加州南部中央谷地，多数年份春季降雨偏少，该病发生较轻；但在沿海及丘陵地区，通常需每年开展药剂防治。观赏海棠亦为寄主。随着植株器官成熟及气温升高，其感病性下降，但夏季若遇持续高湿天气，仍可发生针尖状黑星病斑。  
## 防治

## Comments on the Disease
The fungus survives in dead leaves on the ground. Primary spores are discharged during spring rains and infect young leaves and fruits during prolonged moisture. Secondary spores may spread disease from established infections on trees. A lack of spring rains in most years reduces its importance in California in the southern Central Valley, but as a rule, this disease requires yearly treatments in coastal and foothill districts. Ornamental crab apples are also hosts. As plant parts mature and the weather gets warmer, susceptibility to this disease decreases, but pinpoint scab can occur during extended periods of moisture during summer.
## Management

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：苹果黑星病]  
对该病的抗性会下降，但夏季持续高湿条件下仍可发生针尖状黑星病斑。  
## 防治要点  
黑星病防治的核心目标是减少或阻止春季初侵染。若初侵染严重，将导致坐果不良，并加大整个生长季黑星病防控难度；反之，若有效控制初侵染，则后期再侵染通常不会造成严重危害。黑星病防控成功的关键在于施药时机精准、药液全面覆盖。降雨期、温度及相对湿度均为重要影响因素。由于黑星病防治常需与其他病害及害虫防治协同进行（即组合用药），因此药剂选择与施药时间尤为关键。

## Management
The main objective in scab management is the reduction or prevention of primary infections in spring. Extensive primary infections result in poor fruit set and make scab control during the season more difficult. If primary infections are successfully controlled, secondary infections will not be serious. The key to success in scab control is exact timing and full coverage. Wet periods, temperature, and relative humidity are important factors. Because scab control often is part of a combination treatment aimed at other diseases and insect control, choice of materials and timing are also extremely important.

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：苹果黑星病]  
防治其他病虫害时所选用的药剂种类及施药时期，对苹果黑星病的防控效果同样极为重要。  
秋季叶面喷施硫酸锌与尿素，可促进叶片提早脱落，并加快落地病叶的腐解，从而降低越冬苹果黑星病初侵染源的数量。  
## 有机认证允许的防治方法  
使用石灰硫磺合剂、单用硫制剂，或经批准的碱式硫酸铜等铜制剂，均属有机认证允许的防治措施。

A fall foliar fertilizer application of zinc sulfate and urea hastens leaf fall and speeds decomposition of fallen leaves. This in turn reduces the level of overwintering apple scab inoculum.
## Organically Acceptable Methods
Treatments with lime and sulfur, sulfur alone, or with approved fixed copper products are organically acceptable.

苹果黑星病的发生可依据温度和湿度条件进行预测。下表引自Mills与La Plante的研究，列出了春季在持续湿润条件下，不同温度下初侵染孢子（子囊孢子）引发侵染所需的最短时间（小时数）。该黑星病预测及喷药时机指导系统已在加利福尼亚州北部苹果产区得到验证，但在中部和南部圣华金河谷地区不适用，因当地春季气温普遍高于表中所列温度。

Apple scab outbreaks can be predicted based on temperature and moisture conditions. 查表方法：将降雨期的最高温和最低温相加后除以2，即得该降雨期的平均温度。若湿润期呈间歇性，则累计各湿润时段时长，直至出现至少连续6小时的干燥期为止。为高效完成此项工作，需使用叶面湿度记录仪。若干燥期为晴天，且树体干燥迅速、彻底，则认为树体干燥后6小时，侵染危险即已解除；若干燥缓慢、空气湿度仍较高，则需在6小时干燥期基础上额外增加3～4小时的安全余量。

How to use the table : Figure the average temperature for the rain period by adding the maximum and the minimum temperatures and dividing by 2. If wet periods are intermittent, total their durations until there is a period of at least 6 hours of continuous dryness. You will need a wetness recorder to do this efficiently. If the dry period is sunny, and drying is quick and thorough, it is assumed that 6 hours after the trees have dried, the danger is passed. If drying is slow, and humidity remains high, then the 6-hour dry period is extended by a safety margin of 3 to 4 hours. Treatment Decisions Unless wetness periods are being monitored as outlined in the section above, apply protective fungicides at regular intervals beginning with green tip . Be sure to monitor wetness periods throughout the spring to ensure that trees are adequately protected. text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：蜜环菌根腐病（橡树根腐病）]  
受蜜环菌（Armillaria mellea）侵染的根系，在树皮与木质部之间可见白色至黄白色的扇形菌丝层；根表有时可见深褐色至黑色的根状菌索。苹果砧木对蜜环菌具有一定抗性，但若土壤中菌源量高、所侵染的蜜环菌菌株致病力强，或果树本身已因其他因素衰弱，则该抗性可能被克服。  
## 病害说明  
该菌可在死亡根系上长期存活。  
## 防治方法  
目前尚无真正有效的蜜环菌根腐病防治措施。  
对感染蜜环菌的果树，暴露其感病的根颈及上部根系，可阻止菌体向根颈部位扩展，从而促使树体重新萌发新根。
title: armillaria-root-rot-oak-root-fungus
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: armillaria-root-rot-oak-root-fungus]
Roots infected with Armillaria mellea have white to yellowish fan-shaped mycelial mats between the bark and the wood. Dark brown to black rhizomorphs sometimes can be seen on the root surface. Apple rootstocks have some
resistance to Armillaria, but if the
level of inoculum is high in the soil and the strain of Armillaria is highly virulent, or the tree is already weakened
by some other factor, the fungus can overcome this resistance.
## Comments on the Disease
The fungus survives on dead roots.
## Management
There is no truly effective control for Armillaria root rot.
Exposing an infected crown and upper root area of a tree infected with Armillaria
mellea will stop
the development of the fungus into the crown area and allow the tree to regrow.

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：蜜环菌根腐病（橡树根腐病）]  
感染蜜环菌（Armillaria mellea）的苹果树，可通过阻止病菌向树干基部（根颈）扩展，促使树体重新萌发新根。春季，将树干基部周围土壤扒开，深度达23～30厘米，并在整个生长季内保持树干基部裸露。春、夏、秋季均应尽量保持上层根系及根颈部位干燥。

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：欧洲溃疡病]  
秋季或春季，欧洲溃疡病在小枝条叶痕下方形成红褐色病斑，随后扩展为具同心环状隆起的溃疡斑，春季可导致枝梢枯死。若采收前遇降雨，果实易发生花萼腐烂。修剪伤口感染偶有发生（尤其在“红玉”品种上）。此类伤口感染在表观检查时易与火疫病混淆。  
## 病害说明  
该病菌在老树皮溃疡斑内越冬，秋季降雨时产生孢子，经新鲜叶痕侵入。红玉品种最感病，其次为格兰尼史密斯和罗马美人。在索诺玛县塞巴斯托波尔地区，若秋季持续多雨，则该病发生严重。  
## 防治
title: european-canker
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: european-canker]
In fall or spring European canker causes reddish brown lesions to appear on small branches just below leaf scars. These elongate into cankers with concentric ridges and may cause dieback of shoots in spring. Calyx rot of fruits can occur in years when rain precedes harvest. Pruning wound infections are seen occasionally (especially on the Delicious cultivar). On superficial examination, such infections may be confused with fire blight.
## Comments on the Disease
This fungus survives in old bark cankers and produces spores that enter fresh leaf scars during fall rains. The Delicious variety is most susceptible, followed by Gravenstein and Rome Beauty. This disease is worse in the Sebastopol area of Sonoma County in years with prolonged fall rains.
## Management

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：欧洲溃疡病]  
‘美人’品种易感。在索诺玛县塞巴斯托波尔地区，若秋季持续阴雨，该病发生尤为严重。  
## 防治措施  
欧洲溃疡病主要通过修剪和喷施保护性杀菌剂进行防治。一旦发现溃疡斑，应及时从树上剪除，否则病斑将导致枝条枯死，并成为病菌再侵染的重要初侵染源。建议于夏季早期及时剪除并烧毁病枝，此时症状明显，且病菌扩散风险较低。由于病菌主要经叶痕侵入，而苹果落叶期较长，因此每年秋季需施药两次，以全面保护新生叶痕。  
## 有机认证允许的防治方法  
波尔多液或经认证的其他铜制剂（如碱式硫酸铜、氢氧化铜等）可用于有机苹果生产。  
## 施药决策
title: european-canker
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: european-canker]
 Beauty. This disease is worse in the Sebastopol area of Sonoma County in years with prolonged fall rains.
## Management
European canker is managed primarily by pruning and protectant fungicides. Cankers should be pruned out of trees as they ultimately kill branches and also serve as sources of inoculum. Prune and burn diseased wood early in summer. At this time symptoms are obvious and spread of the fungus is not likely. Because infection occurs through leaf scars and leaves fall over a long period, two treatments are necessary each fall to protect new leaf scars.
## Organically Acceptable Methods
Treatments with Bordeaux or approved fixed copper materials are organically acceptable.
## Treatment Decisions

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：欧洲溃疡病]  
e 防治方法  
波尔多液或经批准的无机铜制剂可用于有机栽培。  
## 防治决策  
若果园发生欧洲溃疡病且已造成危害，应在叶片初落期、降雨开始前，喷施现配的10:10:100波尔多液，或按标签推荐剂量施用无机铜制剂；病情严重时，可在约四分之三叶片脱落后再施药一次。

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：苹果红蜘蛛（欧洲红蜘蛛）]  
害虫特征与为害  
## 害虫特征  
苹果红蜘蛛以卵越冬；翌年春季果树开花时卵开始孵化。借助手持放大镜，可在小枝、一年生枝条的芽基部和短果枝粗皮处，以及树体伤口中查找越冬卵。越冬卵呈球形、红色，顶部中央具一细长柄（柄状突），卵表面具多条自上而下的纵沟。生长季内，成螨将卵产于叶片上。若螨共3龄。幼螨鲜红色，但每次蜕皮后短暂呈鲜绿色，恢复取食后即转为红色。成螨深红色，背部刚毛基部具6～8个白色斑点。  
## 为害
title: european-red-mite
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: european-red-mite]
Description of the Pest
Damage
## Description of the Pest
European red mites overwinter as eggs ; eggs hatch in spring when trees bloom. With the use of a hand lens, look for overwintering eggs in roughened bark at bases of buds and spurs on smaller branches and twigs, or in wounds. They are globular and red with a slender stalk (stipe) rising from the top center and many grooves extending from top to bottom. During the growing season, eggs are laid on leaves. There are three instars before the adult stage. Immature mites are bright red, except just after molting when they appear bright green. The green color turns to red after the mites resume feeding. Adults are dark red and have six to eight white spots at the base of hairs on the back.
## Damage

[作物：苹果] [病害：苹果红蜘蛛]

## 危害  
严重为害时可导致叶片呈古铜色。宽叶品种（如黄元帅）受害相对较轻，窄叶品种（如红富士）受害较重。  
## 防治  
苹果红蜘蛛在苹果园中偶有严重发生。冬季应进行监测，以确定是否需要防治。休眠期喷施矿物油为首选防治措施。  
## 生物防治

## Damage
Severe mite infestations can cause bronzing of leaves. Damage is relatively less severe on wide leaf varieties such as Yellow Newton and more severe on narrow leaf varieties such as Red Delicious.
## Management
European red mite only occasionally becomes troublesome in apple orchards. Monitor in winter to determine the need for treatment. Dormant oil is the preferred treatment.
## Biological Control

## 生物防治  
若在休眠期使用矿物油将苹果红蜘蛛种群控制在较低水平，则西方钝绥螨、六点始叶螨及食螨瓢虫等天敌可有效维持其低种群水平至整个生长季。应尽量减少或降低对捕食性螨类有杀伤作用的药剂用量。避免使用石硫合剂等可杀死苹果锈螨的药剂。当苹果锈螨得以存活时，上述捕食性螨类可取食其为生，并在加州部分区域形成足够大的种群，从而有效控制苹果红蜘蛛。  
## 农业防治

## Biological Control
If European red mite populations are managed at low levels by treating with a dormant oil, predators including western predatory mite, sixspotted thrips and spider mite destroyer can effectively help to maintain low levels throughout the season. Minimize the use or dosages of materials disruptive to mite predators. Avoid spraying with materials such as lime sulfur which kill the apple rust mite. When apple rust mites are allowed to survive, the predaceous mites feed on them and can build up large enough populations to control European red mites in some areas of California.
## Cultural Control

## 监测与防治决策  
冬季任何时期，均需在果园内随机采集25～100个短果枝。若带虫短果枝比例低于10%，则当年欧洲红蜘蛛一般不会造成严重危害；若带虫短果枝比例超过10%，应在花芽膨大期前喷施矿物油。越接近卵孵化期施药，防治效果越好。若需夏季防治，其防治指标为每叶10～30头成螨，具体数值需根据树龄、品种、树势及天敌（如捕食螨）数量综合判定。

## Monitoring and Treatment Decisions
Anytime during winter collect 25 to 100 fruit spurs from trees throughout the block. If less than 10% of the spurs are infested, European red mite probably will not become a problem that season. If more than 10% of the spurs are infested, an oil spray should be applied before bloom. Control improves the closer eggs are to hatching. If summer control becomes necessary, the thresholds range from 10 to 30 mites per leaf depending on the age, variety, and condition of the tree, and the abundance of the mite predators.

[作物：苹果] [害虫：苹褐卷叶蛾]  
害虫特征与为害  
## 害虫特征  
苹褐卷叶蛾已成为沿海地区有机苹果园的重要害虫，但在内陆河谷地区不构成危害。幼虫为暗褐色毛虫，头部具光泽黑色；成虫为灰褐色小蛾，外形与苹果蠹蛾相似，但体型较小，且腹部中段具一条白色横带。在加州，一年发生2代。越冬代成虫于5月出现并产卵，卵于6月下旬至7月孵化；幼虫在整个夏季取食叶片及果实表面。夏季代成虫于9—10月羽化；该代所产幼虫在越冬庇护所内越冬，翌年早春出土，春季化蛹，5月羽化为成虫。苹褐卷叶蛾的生活史及为害特点与苹果褐卷叶蛾相似，二者可在同一果园共存。
title: eyespotted-bud-moth
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: eyespotted-bud-moth]
Description of the Pest
Damage
## Description of the Pest
Eyespotted bud moth has become an important pest in organic apple orchards in coastal areas but is not a problem in the interior valleys. Larvae are dull brown caterpillars with a shiny black head. Adult moths are gray and similar in appearance to a codling moth but smaller and with a white band across the mid-section. In California, two generations per year have been observed. Adults of the overwintering generation appear in May and lay eggs, which hatch in late June and July. Larvae feed on leaves and the surface of fruits throughout summer. The summer generation adults emerge in September and October. It is believed that the larvae produced by the summer generation overwinter in hibernacula. These larvae emerge in late winter, pupate in spring, and emerge as adults in May. The life cycle and damage from eyespotted budmoth is similar to the apple pandemis moth, and they may co-exist in the same orchard.

[作物：苹果] [病害：苹褐卷蛾]  
苹褐卷蛾的危害与苹果大卷叶蛾相似，二者可在同一果园中同时发生。  
## 危害症状  
幼虫春季主要取食萌发的芽和嫩叶；春末则将叶片卷曲为筒状并在其中化蛹，卷叶内常夹有1片枯死叶片。  
夏季世代幼虫主要为害叶片，卵孵化初期常在叶片上形成“窗斑”（即仅剩叶脉网，叶肉被啃食）；可用手持放大镜检查窗斑部位，可见小型褐色幼虫。幼虫还吐丝将叶片粘附于果实表面，在叶下取食果实，造成单个、浅表的取食斑痕。  
## 防治方法

## Damage
Larvae feed primarily on emerging buds and leaves in spring. They roll leaves later in spring and pupate in these leaf rolls. The leaf rolls often contain a dead leaf in the center.
Larvae of the summer generation feed on leaves; the first sign of egg hatch is often windowpaning of leaves where small areas are chewed out leaving just a web of veins. Check with a hand lens for the presence of the small brown larvae in windowpaned areas. Larvae also attach leaves to the fruit with silk and feed on the fruit under the attached leaf, making individual, shallow feeding marks.
## Management

## 防治方法  
苹小卷叶蛾主要为害有机苹果园，尤其在采用性信息素迷向法防治苹果蠹蛾的果园中易暴发。常规果园中，针对其他害虫喷施的化学杀虫剂可兼治苹小卷叶蛾。该虫仅近年才在有机苹果园中成为突出问题，目前尚在评估有效防控措施。应于5月1日前在果园内悬挂性信息素诱捕器监测苹小卷叶蛾成虫发生动态，并持续维持诱捕器至整个生长季。有机苹果园可视监测结果决定是否开展防治。

## Management
Eyespotted bud moth is primarily a pest in organic apple orchards where pheromone mating disruption for codling moth control is used. In conventional orchards, synthetic pesticides applied for other pests easily control eyespotted budmoth. This insect has become a pest in organic apple orchards only in recent years, and effective control measures are still being evaluated. Monitor eyespotted bud moth flights with pheromone traps, which should be placed in the orchard by May 1. Maintain traps through the growing season. Treatments may be warranted in organic apple orchards.

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：火疫病]  
火疫病导致花序在晚春萎蔫、枯死。病部组织渗出褐色黏液。感病的幼嫩枝梢顶端弯曲呈典型的“羊角状”。  
## 病害说明  
病原菌——梨火疫病菌（Erwinia amylovora）在枝条和主干的溃疡斑中越冬，借雨水飞溅和昆虫传播，花期温暖高湿天气有利于病害发生。树冠上部喷灌会加重发病，尤其在易感火疫病的品种上。危害程度轻者仅个别花或新梢受害，重者可致大枝枯死。
title: fire-blight
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: fire-blight]
Fire blight causes blossom clusters to wilt and collapse in late spring. A brownish, sticky exudate is produced from diseased tissue. The tips of infected young succulent shoots curve into a characteristic shepherd's hook.
## Comments on the Disease
Erwinia amylovora overwinters in twig and branch cankers , is spread by rain splash and insects, and favored by warm, humid weather during bloom. Overhead sprinklers may aggravate the problem, especially in fire blight susceptible cultivars. Damage ranges from individual flower or shoot infections to death of limbs.

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：火疫病]  
尤其在易感火疫病的品种上发生严重。危害程度从单朵花或单个枝条受害，到整枝枯死不等。  
苹果不同品种对火疫病的感病性及受害程度差异较大。例如，‘嘎啦’和‘富士’树体常遭毁灭性危害，而‘澳洲青苹’（Granny Smith）通常仅发生局部感染，一般不会造成树体结构性严重损伤。砧木M26和M9高度感病，若其受侵染，可导致整株死亡。  
## 防治

Apple cultivars vary in susceptibility and extent of damage. For example, in Granny Smith, infections are usually limited and do not cause severe structural damage to the tree whereas Gala and Fuji trees may be devastated. The rootstocks M26 and M9 are very susceptible to this disease, and infections of these rootstocks can cause the trees to die.
## Management

[作物：苹果] [病害：火疫病]  
M9砧木极易感病，该砧木感染后可导致整株死亡。  
## 防治措施  
火疫病的发生发展主要受季节性天气影响。春季温暖、间有降雨和冰雹的天气最利于病害发生。此外，果园所用品种与砧木类型、园址选择、氮肥施用量过大、重修剪或过量灌溉等，均会加重病害发生。防治关键在于维持树体适中长势，花期喷施抗生素或铜制剂，最重要的是及时发现、剪除并销毁病枝（即“火疫病梢”）。对越冬溃疡斑，应彻底剪至健康组织部位。该病害防治难度较大。

nd M9 are very susceptible to this disease, and infections of these rootstocks can cause the trees to die.
## Management
Fire blight development is influenced primarily by seasonal weather. Warm spring weather, accompanied by intermittent rain and hail, is ideal for disease development. Other influences on disease development are the varieties and rootstocks used in the orchard, location of the orchard, application of too much nitrogen fertilizer, heavy pruning, or over-irrigation. Management relies on maintaining trees in the proper range of vigor, applying blossom sprays of antibiotics or copper, and most importantly, promptly finding, removing, and destroying blight strikes. Remove holdover cankers by cutting back to healthy wood. This disease can be difficult to control.

## 监测与防治决策  
在部分苹果产区，花期喷施铜制剂或抗生素链霉素是控制火疫病菌扩散所必需的措施。首次施药时期尤为关键。在加利福尼亚州，常依据日平均气温或积温时数（度时）来确定火疫病喷药时间。目前已有多种基于平均温度和积温时数的预测模型，可用于辅助判断火疫病侵染期及是否需要开展防治，亦可据此确定链霉素和铜制剂的施用时机。

## Monitoring and Treatment Decisions
Blossom applications of copper materials or the antibiotic streptomycin are necessary in some apple-growing areas to reduce the spread of fire blight bacteria. The timing of the first application is critical. In California, average daily temperatures or degree-hours are used to schedule fire blight sprays. Several mean temperature and degree-hour models are available to assist in predicting infection periods and the need for control. These models can be used to time antibiotic and copper treatments.

较新的积温时模型基于对细菌实际生长与侵染条件的评估，可明确指示无需施药的时期。其中一种即为积温时模型，该模型综合考虑初花期及持续低温天气的影响，从而调整施药时间。应用积温时法需在果园内配备记录式温度计，以连续获取果园气温数据。1个积温时指气温高于65°F（约18.3℃）1小时；例如，气温70°F（约21.1℃）持续2小时，则累积10个积温时。每日每小时累加积温时，但若连续3天日均温低于66°F（约18.9℃），则积温时累计值清零，直至气温再次超过65°F（约18.3℃）后重新开始累积。当累计积温时总数已超过400，且同时满足以下任一条件时，即使持续低温，累计值亦不归零：（1）期间出现降水；（2）存在至少持续至57°F（约13.9℃）且相对湿度≥90%的温暖高湿侵染期。若果园实施灌溉，则园外实测相对湿度阈值相应降低至80%。如条件允许，建议在生长季初期即保持土壤水分饱和，以避免花期灌溉。

Newer degree-hour models are based on assessing actual conditions for bacterial growth and infection and also indicate when treatment is unnecessary. One such model is the degree-hour model, which takes into account early bloom and periods of continuous cool weather, allowing adjustments in treatment timings. Use of the degree-hour method requires a recording thermograph to obtain a continuous temperature reading in your orchard. One degree-hour equals 1 degree above 65°F for 1 hour. For example, a temperature of 70°F for 2 hours generates 10 degree-hours. Accumulate degree-hours each hour of the day unless 3 consecutive days below 66°F occur. In this case, the accumulation of degree-hours is then reduced to zero until temperatures again exceed 65°F. The accumulated degree-hour total is not reduced by continuous cool temperatures if the total has surpassed 400 degree-hours and has coincided with precipitation or simultaneous warm, humid infection periods of at least 57°F and 90% relative humidity. If the orchard is being irrigated, the humidity threshold is reduced to 80% relative humidity as measured outside the orchard. If possible, start the season with a full soil water profile so irrigation during bloom can be avoided.

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：疫霉根腐病和颈腐病]  
症状表现取决于受侵染的根系或树干基部组织面积大小及坏死速度。通常，颈腐病发展迅速，果树在春季首次出现暖热天气后很快萎蔫倒伏死亡。病树叶片萎蔫、干枯，但常仍附着于枝条上。慢性侵染多发生于根系，导致树势衰弱、生长减缓，并提早衰老落叶；此类病树可维持数年不良长势后才最终死亡。疫霉菌侵染常导致幼树死亡，因其根系及树干基部组织较成年树小得多。  
## 防治
title: phytophthora-root-and-crown-rot
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: phytophthora-root-and-crown-rot]
Symptom expression depends upon how much of the root or crown tissues are affected and how quickly they are destroyed. Generally, crown rots advance rapidly and trees collapse and die soon after the first warm weather of spring. Leaves of such trees wilt , dry, and remain attached to the tree. Chronic infections, usually of the roots, cause reduction in growth and early senescence and leaf fall. These trees may be unthrifty for several years before succumbing to the disease. Phytophthora infections typically kill young trees because their root systems and crown areas are small compared to those of mature trees.
## Management

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：疫霉根腐病和颈腐病]  
该病可导致幼树死亡，因其根系及根颈部位较成年树小。  
## 防治措施  
科学的水分管理是防控根腐病和颈腐病的关键。切勿使水分在树干基部（根颈）处积聚或长时间滞留。应完善排水系统，或在果园中保留未种植的低洼地（即易涝区）及土壤渗透性差的区域；宜采用起垄栽培。一旦疫霉菌侵入果园，病原菌将长期存活，无法根除。须严防带菌苗木、受污染的灌溉水及沾染病土的农机具将病原带入无病地块。土壤持续饱和达24小时以上，极易诱发疫霉病害；反之，改善土壤排水条件，并采用高频次、短时长的灌溉方式（如脉冲式灌溉），可显著降低根腐病和颈腐病发生风险。不同苹果砧木对各类疫霉菌的感病性存在差异，目前尚无对所有致病疫霉菌均具抗性的砧木品种。因此，砧木的抗病效果部分取决于果园中实际存在的疫霉菌种类。总体而言，MM104和MM106较M9和M26更易感病。化学药剂防治可有效减轻损失。
title: phytophthora-root-and-crown-rot
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: phytophthora-root-and-crown-rot]
y kill young trees because their root systems and crown areas are small compared to those of mature trees.
## Management
Proper water management is the key to controlling root and crown rot. Do not allow water to accumulate or stand around crowns of trees. Provide adequate drainage or leave unplanted low spots in the orchard, areas that flood frequently, and places where water penetration is poor. Plant on berms. Once Phytophthora is present in your orchard, the pathogen will remain; eradication is impossible. Avoid introducing infected plant material, infested irrigation water, or infested soil on farm equipment into uncontaminated soil. Periods of 24 hours or more of saturated soil favor Phytophthora infections. Conversely, good soil drainage and more frequent but shorter irrigations (e.g. pulse irrigation) reduce the risk of root and crown rot. Rootstocks vary in susceptibility to the different Phytophthora species; none are resistant to all pathogenic species of the fungus. Thus, the success of a rootstock may depend in part upon the species of Phytophthora present in the orchard. In general, MM 104 and MM 106 are more susceptible than are M 9 and M 26. Fungicides can help minimize losses.

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：白粉病]  
白粉病典型症状为叶片和新梢表面出现白色粉状物，导致幼嫩组织生长受阻、畸形。感病果实发育迟缓、果面产生锈斑，坐果率亦可能降低。  
## 病害说明  
该病是苹果叶部重要病害。病菌以菌丝体在顶芽内越冬，越冬芽呈白色、扁平、尖削状。温暖的白天与凉爽潮湿的夜间条件有利于病害发生发展。  
## 防治
title: powdery-mildew
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: powdery-mildew]
Powdery mildew is distinguished by superficial, white powdery growth on leaves and shoots that results in the stunting and distortion of young growth. Infected fruit are stunted and russetted , and fruit set may be reduced.
## Comments on the Disease
This is a major foliage disease of apples. The fungus overwinters in terminal buds that are white, flattened, and pointed. Disease development is favored by warm days and cool, moist nights.
## Management

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：白粉病]  
病斑呈白色、扁平、尖状。温暖的白天和凉爽潮湿的夜晚有利于病害发生发展。  
## 防治措施  
白粉病主要通过休眠期或早春剪除感病枝条，并于春季适时喷药，以抑制菌量积累、减轻对果实的危害。修剪时应彻底剪除感病枝梢。白粉病的化学防治常与苹果黑星病防治相结合进行，具体施药时期及药剂选择需根据果园实际情况确定。  
## 有机认证允许的防治方法  
可通过修剪，结合施用石灰硫磺合剂、单用硫磺或某些园艺矿物油进行防治，适用于有机认证苹果生产。  
## 施药决策
title: powdery-mildew
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: powdery-mildew]
hat are white, flattened, and pointed. Disease development is favored by warm days and cool, moist nights.
## Management
Powdery mildew is managed primarily by pruning infected shoots during dormancy or in early spring and by applying sprays as necessary in spring to prevent buildup of the fungus and damage to the crop. Remove infected shoot tips at pruning. Chemical control of powdery mildew is done in conjunction with controls for scab. Timing and choice of material may vary from orchard to orchard.
## Organically Acceptable Methods
Pruning and treatments with lime and sulfur, sulfur alone, or certain horticultural oils can be used to treat organically certified produce.
## Treatment Decisions

[作物：苹果] [病害：白粉病]

## 防治时机决策  
推荐在花蕾露红期施药。若果园中白粉病持续发生，需继续施药，直至新梢停止生长。

## 害虫特征  
成雌螨体型较欧洲红螨更大、更细长，体色呈绿色至黄色；取食期雌螨体侧各具1个深色斑点，随取食可逐渐扩大至覆盖大部分体表。越冬雌螨呈橙红色，潜伏于树干翘皮下及地面杂草、落叶等残体中。3月下旬至4月上旬开始沿树干向上迁移，取食叶片。高温干旱条件下繁殖迅速，7—8月达为害高峰期。卵微小、球形，无色至浅稻草色，散产于受害区域。  

## 为害症状
title: webspinning-spider-mites
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: webspinning-spider-mites]
Description of the Pest

## Description of the Pest
Adult female mites are larger and more elongated than European red mites and are green to yellow . Feeding mites have a dark spot on either side of the body that may enlarge to cover most of the body. Overwintering females are orange and hibernate under bark scales on the tree and in trash on the ground. They move up the tree in late March and April, feeding on leaves. Rapid reproduction occurs in hot, dry weather and the infestation peaks in July and August. The tiny, spherical, colorless to straw-colored eggs are distributed over the infested area.
## Damage

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：结网型叶螨]  
7—8月。微小、球形、无色至稻草色的卵散布于受害区域。  
## 危害症状  
叶螨刺吸叶片汁液，取食叶肉细胞内含物，导致叶片出现细密斑点状失绿；严重为害时，叶片呈明显古铜色，并提前落叶。重发果园中，果实着色不良、膨大受阻，翌年产量亦可能下降。  
## 防治措施  
结网型叶螨通常在夏季高温期（尤其是果园内多尘、水分胁迫严重的区域）种群数量达高峰。多数果园中，天敌可将其控制在经济阈值以下。6—8月应定期调查叶螨及其天敌种群动态，以决定是否需开展药剂防治。  
## 抗性品种
title: webspinning-spider-mites
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: webspinning-spider-mites]

## Damage
Mites feed upon leaves , removing the cell contents and gradually giving leaves a finely stippled appearance. Heavy infestations result in severe bronzing of foliage and premature defoliation. Fruits on heavily infested trees fail to color and size properly, and fruit production for the following year may be lowered.
## Management
Webspinning spider mites are typically most abundant during the hot summer months, especially in dusty and water-stressed areas of the orchard. Natural enemies keep spider mites below damaging levels in many orchards. Monitor for mites and their natural enemies from June through August to determine the need for treatment.
## Resistant Varieties

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：叶螨（结网型）]  
6月至8月定期调查叶螨及其天敌种群数量，以确定是否需要开展防治。  
## 抗性品种  
红富士、金冠、罗马及乔纳金等品种较易受叶螨为害；而格兰尼史密斯和黄新顿等品种在中等虫口密度下叶片受害症状较轻。  
## 生物防治
title: webspinning-spider-mites
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: webspinning-spider-mites]
for mites and their natural enemies from June through August to determine the need for treatment.
## Resistant Varieties
Varieties such as Red Delicious, Golden Delicious, Rome Beauty, and Jonathan are more susceptible to mite injury, while Gravenstein and Yellow Newtown show less evidence of leaf damage from moderate populations.
## Biological Control

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：叶螨（结网型）]  
格雷文斯坦和黄纽顿品种在中等种群密度下叶片受害症状较轻。  
## 生物防治  
西方捕食螨（学名：Galendromus occidentalis，旧称Metaseiulus occidentalis）是结网型叶螨的优良天敌。目前已培育出对西维因及苹果生产中常用多数有机磷类杀虫剂具有抗性的捕食螨品系。为有效控制叶螨，需维持捕食螨与结网型叶螨1∶10的比例。应降低杀螨剂使用剂量，以减少对天敌的杀伤，并保留少量叶螨作为捕食螨的食物来源。苹果锈螨可作为捕食螨的替代食物。应避免使用含石灰硫磺合剂的药剂，因其会杀死锈螨。当允许替代食物源存活时，捕食螨种群可增长至足够数量，从而有效控制结网型叶螨种群。
title: webspinning-spider-mites
text_en:
[作物: apple] [病害: webspinning-spider-mites]

## Biological Control
The western predatory mite , Galendromus (=Metaseiulus) occidentalis, is an excellent predator of webspinning mites. Predator mites have been developed that are resistant to carbaryl and most organophosphates used in apples. One predator to 10 webspinning mites is necessary for the predators to keep control of the pest mites. Use lower rates of miticides to minimize destruction of predators and allow some spider mites to survive. The apple rust mite is an alternative food source for the predator mite. Avoid sprays containing lime sulfur, which will kill rust mites. When alternative food sources are allowed to survive, the predaceous mites can build up large enough numbers to control webspinning mite populations.

text:
[作物：苹果] [病害：结网型叶螨]  
若允许其存活，捕食性螨类可大量增殖，从而有效控制结网型叶螨种群。  
## 农业防治  
果园种植禾本科生草覆盖作物并采用喷灌，有助于减少尘土；保证充足灌溉，避免树体水分胁迫；生草覆盖作物不可刈割过低或任其干枯，否则叶螨易上树为害。  
## 有机农业允许的防治方法

Grass cover crops and sprinkler irrigation help to minimize dust in orchards. Provide adequate irrigation to avoid water stress. Do not mow the cover crop too short or let it dry, or the mites may move up into the trees.

From July to August, or if you encounter high mite populations earlier in the season, collect five spur leaves at spaced intervals from one lateral branch located at eye level from each of 20 marked trees that have been established as representative trees in a block. ## 害虫描述

斑翅果蝇已在加利福尼亚州所有蓝莓种植县定殖，但在沿海地区危害尤为严重。成虫和幼虫（蛆）外形与常见醋蝇（黑腹果蝇，Drosophila melanogaster）及其他主要为害腐烂或发酵果实的果蝇属（Drosophila）种类极为相似。但斑翅果蝇可在果实采收前直接为害完好无损的健康果实。

## Description of the Pest
( View male/female identification card )
Spotted-wing drosophila is established in all California counties where blueberries are grown but is of greatest concern in areas along the coast. Adults and larvae (maggots) closely resemble the common vinegar fly, Drosophila melanogaster, and other Drosophila species that primarily attack rotting or fermenting fruit. Spotted-wing drosophila, however, attacks undamaged fruit prior to harvest.

text:
［作物：蓝莓］［害虫：斑翅果蝇］  
一般果蝇主要为害腐烂或发酵的果实，而斑翅果蝇则在采收前直接为害完好无损的果实。  
成虫体型较小（2–3毫米），复眼红色，胸部淡褐色，腹部具黑色横纹；雄虫最显著的特征是每只翅尖附近具1个黑斑；雌虫产卵器粗大且呈锯齿状，可刺入薄皮果实表皮，在单个果实内产卵1–3粒，且可在多个果实上重复产卵。  
卵产于果实表皮下，借助手持放大镜可观察到卵壳外露于果面的2根白色呼吸管。
title: spotted-wing-drosophila

[作物: blueberry] [病害: spotted-wing-drosophila]
rimarily attack rotting or fermenting fruit. Spotted-wing drosophila, however, attacks undamaged fruit prior to harvest.
Adults are small (2–3 mm) flies with red eyes, a pale brown thorax, and abdomen with black stripes. The most distinguishable trait of the adult is that the males have a black spot near the tip of each wing. The female ovipositor is very large and serrated, so it is able to penetrate the skin of soft-skinned fruit and lay one to three eggs in each. The female will lay eggs in many fruit.
Eggs are laid within the fruit skin and can be recognized with a hand lens by two white breathing tubes that extend out of the surface of the fruit.

Larvae are tiny (up to 3.5 mm), white, cylindrical maggots that are found feeding in fruit. One or more larvae may be found feeding within a single fruit. After maturing, the larvae partially or completely exit the fruit to pupate .
Spotted-wing drosophila prefers mild, humid weather that usually occurs throughout the year in coastal areas of California and during the spring and fall in inland valleys. Peak activity occurs when temperatures are in the 60s and 70s (°F), which is typical during harvest seasons across all production regions of the state.

## 危害  
与其他在加州发生的醋蝇不同，斑翅果蝇是一种重要害虫，可在采收前直接为害健康果实。雌成虫产卵及幼虫取食会破坏果实完整性，导致普通醋蝇（如黑腹果蝇）亦在受损果实中产卵。受害果实还可能成为次生真菌和细菌病原菌的侵染通道，但并非必然发生。田间常难见明显症状，往往至果实上市时才被发现：果实变软、货架期显著缩短。雌成虫产卵于果皮下，形成微小凹陷（称“刺孔”）。单个果实内可存在多个幼虫，因雌虫可在同一果实内产多粒卵，且多头雌虫可共同在同果上产卵。幼虫在果肉内发育取食，致果肉褐变、软化；轻压受害果实，可见卵孔处渗出汁液。

## Damage
Unlike other vinegar flies that occur in California, spotted-wing drosophila is a significant pest that attacks healthy fruit prior to harvest. As fruit integrity is compromised by oviposition and larval feeding, common vinegar flies (i.e., Drosophila melanogaster) may also oviposit in the damaged fruit. Damage can also provide entry for infection by secondary fungal and bacterial pathogens, but this is not always the case. Often damage is not seen until the fruit is at the market; fruit is soft and has a reduced shelf-life. Oviposition creates a small depression ("sting") on the fruit surface. Many larvae are possible within a single fruit because females can lay more than one egg in each fruit and multiple females will oviposit on the same fruit. Maggots develop and feed inside the fruit, causing the flesh to turn brown and soft. When infested fruit are gently squeezed, fluid exudes out of the hole in the fruit surface where the egg was laid.

只要感虫期果实与斑翅果蝇同时存在，即需开展防治。应依据田间发生史及诱捕器监测结果施药，重点在于阻止成虫产卵；杀虫剂对已侵入果实内的幼虫无效。

目前尚未发现斑翅果蝇的有效天敌。

有机蓝莓种植者唯一可用的防治药剂为多杀菌素（Entrust制剂）。

## Management
Management of spotted-wing drosophila is required any time susceptible fruit and flies are present at the same time. Apply insecticides based on field history and trap catches, with the goal of preventing oviposition; insecticides do not control larvae within the fruit.
## Biological Control
Spotted-wing drosophila natural enemies have not been observed.
## Organically Acceptable Methods
Application of the Entrust formulation of spinosad is the only control method available to organic blueberry growers.
## Resistance Management

## 抗药性管理  
施用杀虫剂时，抗药性管理极为重要。果蝇类害虫在长期、频繁使用同一种杀虫剂的情况下，极易产生抗药性。此外，多杀菌素和氰戊菊酯也是柑橘蓟马季节中后期防治的关键杀虫剂。若同一生长季内需同时防控这两种害虫，应科学统筹杀虫剂使用方案，以降低两种害虫同时产生抗药性的风险。

## Resistance Management
When applying pesticides, it is extremely important to consider resistance management. Drosophila flies have a history of rapidly developing resistance to insecticides that are used repeatedly and frequently. Additionally, insecticides such as spinosad and fenpropathrin are also two of the key insecticides used for citrus thrips control later in the season. If control of both pests within a season is needed, carefully plan the insecticide treatments in a way that reduces the risk of resistance development for both pests.

诱捕器需能盛装液体。  
诱捕器应可悬挂在蓝莓树冠内铁丝上。

## Monitoring
Monitor spotted-wing drosophila using homemade traps.
Make a trap capable of holding liquid.
Traps should be able to hang from a wire within the blueberry canopy.
Traps need holes or other openings in them to release the scent of the bait, and for spotted-wing drosophila to enter the trap. Holes should not be too big or larger nontarget insects can enter.
The two most common versions of these traps are various sized bottles with 3/16-inch holes drilled in them or containers with mesh on top .
Bait traps with 1/2 to 1 cup of apple cider vinegar (depending on the size of the trap).
Add 1 teaspoon of a dishwashing detergent per gallon of apple cider vinegar to increase the number of flies that fall into the liquid bait and drown.

If trapping programs indicate the presence of adult spotted-wing drosophila, apply an insecticide when the first berries begin to turn pink, with a second application just prior to harvest. 黑莓和树莓感染蜜环菌根腐病后的症状因病害发展程度不同而异。早期常见症状为叶片萎蔫和枝条枯死。严重时植株整株死亡。感病主根及根颈部位常在皮层下形成灰白色至乳白色的菌丝层，呈扇形，厚度约与纸张相当，并具有典型的蘑菇气味。在活体或刚死亡的组织上形成此类扇形菌丝层，几乎仅为蜜环菌所特有。若在活株根部皮层下或根颈部位发现此类菌丝层，则基本可判定植株衰退由蜜环菌引起。
title: armillaria-root-rot
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: armillaria-root-rot]
Symptoms of Armillaria root rot on blackberry and raspberry vary depending on how far the disease has progressed. Leaf wilting and cane dieback are common early symptoms early symptoms. In severe cases the plants will die. Infected main roots and crowns often have whitish to cream-colored mycelial mats just under the bark. The mats are fan shaped and about as thick as a piece of paper; they have a characteristic mushroom odor. This is virtually the only fungus that produces these mycelial fans on live or recently alive tissue. If mycelial mats are present under the bark of the roots or in the collar region of live plants, it is a good indication that Armillaria is the cause of the decline.

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：蜜环菌根腐病]  
若在活株的根部或根颈部位发现病斑，通常表明植株衰退由蜜环菌引起。  
常呈片状发病，发病植株群与土壤中初侵染源的位置相对应。若不加防治，病菌会通过菌索在土壤中不断扩展蔓延。菌索为分枝状结构，直径约3～4毫米，外观似根但颜色深暗；单条菌索由白色菌丝束构成，外包一层深红至黑色的外皮。菌索自病株根系延伸至邻近健康植株根系，在土中穿行传播。因菌索形似鞋带，该病原菌俗称“鞋带菌”或“鞋带状真菌”。

Groups of plants are usually infected and show symptoms, correlating with the location of the inoculum in the soil. If the disease is not controlled, it eventually spreads through the soil by the growth of rhizomorphs. Rhizomorphs are branched structures about 0.12 to 0.16 inch (3–4 mm) in diameter that look like roots but are dark colored. A single rhizomorph is a white mycelial strand encased in a dark red to black rind. It grows through the soil from the roots of infected plants to the healthy roots of neighboring plants. Because rhizomorphs resemble shoestrings, some of the common names for this pathogen are bootlace or shoestring fungus.

蜜环菌有时于秋季和冬季在感病植株基部周围产生子实体（蘑菇），子实体体型较大，菌盖呈黄褐色，菌柄上部紧贴菌盖下方具一明显菌环。  
## 病害说明  
蜜环菌根腐病的症状表现及危害程度受寄主植物种类与树龄、蜜环菌种属以及环境条件等多种因素影响。

[作物: caneberries] [病害: armillaria-root-rot]
 Because rhizomorphs resemble shoestrings, some of the common names for this pathogen are bootlace or shoestring fungus.
Armillaria sometimes produces mushrooms around the base of infected plants in fall and winter. The mushrooms are relatively large and have a yellowish brown cap as well as a ring around the stem just below the cap.
## Comments on the Disease
The characteristics and severity of an Armillaria root rot infection are influenced by the type and age of the host plant as well as the species of Armillaria. Environmental conditions also affect disease severity.

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：蜜环菌根腐病]  
寄主植物的品种、树龄以及蜜环菌的种类均影响病害发生程度，环境条件也会影响病害严重度。  
蜜环菌侵染源为土壤中带菌的根系。在清除感病橡树后的地块上也可能发生该病。病菌可在死亡根系上长期存活，并以根状菌索形式在土壤中蔓延。健康根系与菌丝体或根状菌索接触即可导致侵染。根状菌索在病害传播中的作用因蜜环菌种类、地点及环境条件而异。感病植株拔除后，残留在土壤中的病根可使病菌存活多年，成为后续侵染的主要初侵染源。

The source of an Armillaria infection is from infected roots in the soil. The disease can occur on land that has been cleared of infected oak trees. The fungus can survive on dead roots and grow through the soil as rhizomorphs. Infection of plants occurs through the contact of healthy roots with mycelia or rhizomorphs. The importance of rhizomorphs in the spread of the disease varies with species, site, and environmental conditions. The fungus can survive years in roots left in the soil after an infected plant has been removed and this can be considered to be primary inoculum for further infection.

text:
[作物：黑莓类浆果] [病害：蜜环菌根腐病]

诊断蜜环菌根腐病时，应同步开展植株健康状况评估，因该病原菌常侵染受胁迫或其他因素削弱的植株。  
## 防治措施  
清除并销毁土壤中的感病根系或树桩，可降低蜜环菌侵染风险。但彻底清除土壤中所有感病根系难度较大，此法仅能延缓病害扩展。清除时应重点挖除直径约0.5英寸（约1.27厘米）以上的根系。

An assessment of plant health should be made in conjunction with the diagnosis of Armillaria root rot because the pathogen often infects plants that have been weakened by stress or other agents.
## Management
The potential for infection by Armillaria can be reduced by the removal and destruction of infected roots or stumps from the soil. It is very difficult to remove all infected roots from the soil, but the progression of the disease can be slowed by this method. Remove all roots larger than about one half inch in diameter.

虽然效果并非完全可靠，但在受侵染地块邻近区域，可设置屏障以阻止菌索蔓延。屏障可采用垂直埋设的塑料板、沟渠，或定期耕翻的隔离带。

## 有机认证作物允许使用的防治方法  
在有机认证作物中，合理的地块准备措施（包括清除土壤中感病根系，并在土壤中设置物理阻隔屏障以限制病原菌扩散）属于允许使用的综合管理措施。部分木霉菌（Trichoderma）制剂已在生产中应用，对延缓感病根系中病原菌的扩展具有一定效果。此外，将植株基部周围土壤扒开至约15～20厘米深（或直至露出上层根系），该措施已在梨、桃、李和葡萄上证实可有效抑制病原菌扩展，并促进植株恢复。  
## 防治决策

## Organically Acceptable Methods
Proper site preparation, including the removal of infected roots in the soil and the installation of barriers in the soil to contain the pathogen, are acceptable management tools in an organically certified crop. Formulations of the beneficial fungus Trichoderma have been used with some success for delaying pathogen growth in infected roots. Also, the practice of removing soil from around the plant to a depth of about 6 to 8 inches or to a depth that exposes the upper root system has been shown to stop the pathogens progress and allow plant recovery in pears, peaches, plums, and grapes.
## Treatment Decisions

text:
［作物：浆果类藤本植物］［病害：灰霉果腐病］  
晚冬时节，感染灰霉病的黑莓和树莓植株上，枝条褪绿变白，其表面可见扁平、黑色的菌核团块。春季遇有游离水时，菌核萌发，产生大量灰白色菌丝及分生孢子（即分生孢子）。开放的花器可被侵染，病菌在枯死的花器上产孢。受侵染的小核果（瘦果）初期呈水渍状腐烂，随后出现灰褐色分生孢子及菌丝，最终整个果实被分生孢子和菌丝覆盖。留在藤蔓上的病果逐渐干缩成僵果。若采收后天气潮湿，花托亦可被病菌侵染并形成菌核。在采后贮藏期间，病果表面可长出白色菌丝。
title: botrytis-fruit-rot
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: botrytis-fruit-rot]
Flattened black masses of sclerotia appear on the bleached appearing canes of Botrytis -infested blackberry and raspberry plants in late winter. In the presence of free water during spring, sclerotia germinate to form masses of gray mycelium and spores called conidia. Opened flowers may become infected, and the fungus will sporulate on the blighted flowers. On infected drupelets, a watery rot may precede the development of grayish brown conidia and hyphae. The conidia and hyphae eventually cover the fruit. Infected berries left on the vines become mummified. If the weather is moist after harvest, the receptacles can be colonized by the fungus and sclerotia can develop. In postharvest storage, white mycelia can cover infected berries.
## Comments on the Disease

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：灰霉果腐病]

灰霉果腐病在低温高湿条件下发生。病原菌萌发菌核、孢子及侵染均需游离水。果实机械损伤会加重病害发生，尤其在雨季。病原菌以菌核形式在病枝上越冬，亦可在地面病叶和病枝中以菌丝体越冬。初侵染源主要为越冬菌核和枯死叶片上产生的分生孢子，以及僵果上产生的分生孢子。分生孢子借风、雨水及喷灌水传播。花器在开放前不感病，开放后始具感病性。侵染多呈潜伏状态，直至果实近成熟期或采收后才显症。整个生育期可因植株上残留的未采摘、渗汁或过熟果实持续产生分生孢子而反复侵染。
title: botrytis-fruit-rot
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: botrytis-fruit-rot]
 and sclerotia can develop. In postharvest storage, white mycelia can cover infected berries.
## Comments on the Disease
Botrytis fruit rot occurs under cool, wet conditions. The pathogen requires free water for sclerotial germination, spore germination, and infection. Physical damage to the fruit increases disease incidence, especially during the rainy season. The pathogen overwinters as sclerotia on infected canes and as mycelium in infected leaves and canes on the ground. The main sources of primary inoculum are conidia from overwintering sclerotia and dead leaves, and conidia from mummified berries. Conidia are dispersed by wind, rain, and overhead irrigation. Flowers are not susceptible to infection until they are open. Infections generally remain dormant until fruit is nearly ripe or after harvest. Infections can recur throughout the season by sporulation of the fungus on unpicked, leaky, overripe fruit left on the vine.

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：灰霉果腐病]  
病菌可在植株上未采摘、渗汁或过熟的果实上持续产孢，导致整个生育期反复侵染。  
## 防治措施  
通过修剪和搭架使植株通风透光，加快植株组织干燥；采用修剪、控制氮肥施用及杂草防除等措施维持窄行栽培；合理选用整形修剪方式亦有助于保持冠层通透。使用大拱棚可显著降低灰霉病发生程度，因其为植株创造了相对干燥的环境。

## Management
To promote air circulation and quicken drying of plant tissue, prune and trellis the plants to open the canopy. A narrow row can be maintained by pruning, minimizing nitrogen fertilizer application, and controlling weeds. Training systems also help to maintain an open canopy. The use of macrotunnels greatly limits the amount of gray mold infestation because of the dry conditions they create for the plants.

[作物：树莓类] [病害：灰霉果腐病]  
防雨棚栽培可显著降低灰霉病发生程度，因其为植株创造了干燥环境。  
红树莓品种中已有对该病的部分抗性种质。为预防采后果实腐烂，应在果实转红成熟期（即达充分成熟前）及时采收；采收时避免造成果实损伤；果实应直接装入包装容器，并采用浅型容器以防挤压；需勤采、早采，宜在清晨气温较低时进行；采后应尽快将果实预冷至0℃。贮藏温度应保持在0℃，以维持果实硬度并防止密闭果篮或塑料盒内结露。  
## 有机认证允许的防治方法

Partial resistance to this disease is available for red raspberry cultivars. To prevent postharvest fruit rot, pick fruit when it is in the red ripe stage of development (before reaching full maturity). Avoid fruit injury when picking. Pack fruit directly into containers, and use shallow containers to avoid crushing. Pick fruit often, and pick early in the day when temperatures are cool; cool fruit to 32°F as soon as possible after harvest. Store fruit at 32°F to maintain firmness and to prevent condensation inside the closed basket or clamshell.
## Organically Acceptable Methods

## 有机认证作物允许采用的防治方法  
修剪枝条或采用搭架栽培系统以改善冠层通风透光、科学施肥、杂草防控、选用抗病品种以及规范采收操作等措施，均适用于有机认证作物。  
## 施药决策  
从初花期至采收期，每隔7～14天喷施一次保护性杀菌剂。

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：枝叶锈病]  
枝叶锈病发生于部分黑莓品种，尤以奥利莓等蔓生型品种为重。该病初发症状为柠檬黄色夏孢子堆（夏孢子囊），破裂寄主结果枝表皮；感病黑莓的结果枝上可见此类病斑。夏孢子堆产生的夏孢子可侵染叶片，在初夏时节于叶背形成小型黄色夏孢子堆。若病情严重，可导致早期落叶。秋季初期，叶面夏孢子堆间陆续产生浅褐色冬孢子堆。  
需注意区分此常见黑莓病害与较少见但危害严重得多的橙锈病——后者会导致植株基部萌发大量细弱枝条。
title: cane-and-leaf-rust
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: cane-and-leaf-rust]
Cane and leaf rust occurs on some blackberry cultivars, especially trailing varieties such as olallieberry. The first symptom of cane and leaf rust is lemon yellow pustules (uredinia) that split the bark of the fruiting canes of susceptible blackberries. Spores from these pustules (urediniospores) infect leaves and produce small yellow pustules (uredinia) on the underside of leaves during early summer. Defoliation can occur if infection is severe. Buff-colored telia develop among the uredinia on leaves in early fall.
It is important not to confuse this common blackberry disease with the less common but far more damaging orange rust, which causes plants to produce many small, weak shoots from the base of the plant.
## Comments on the Disease

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：枝叶锈病]  
该病可导致植株基部萌发大量细弱新梢。  
## 病害说明  
感病黑莓品种常发生严重落叶，致使植株长势衰弱。枝叶锈病通常不侵染果实，但大量孢子散落于果实表面，会导致果实失去商品价值。树莓虽为寄主，但该病在树莓上发生极为罕见。春季多雨潮湿条件有利于病害发生。病菌以菌丝体或潜伏性夏孢子堆在枝条上越冬。枝叶锈病与橙锈病的区别在于：前者在枝条和叶片上均可见黄色夏孢子堆，而后者仅在叶片上形成橙色夏孢子堆。  
## 防治
title: cane-and-leaf-rust
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: cane-and-leaf-rust]
ange rust, which causes plants to produce many small, weak shoots from the base of the plant.
## Comments on the Disease
On susceptible blackberry varieties leaf defoliation can be severe and result in the loss of plant vigor. Normally cane and leaf rust doesn't infect the fruit but masses of spores falling on fruit can render it unmarketable. Raspberries are hosts, but occurrence of this disease on this crop is rare. Wet spring conditions will favor disease development. The fungus overwinters on canes as mycelium or latent uredinia. Cane and leaf rust can be distinguished from orange rust by the presence of yellow pustules (uredinia) on both the canes and leaves. Orange rust has orange pustules on leaves only.
## Management

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：枝叶锈病]  
叶片和枝条上均出现黄色夏孢子堆（夏孢子堆）；橙锈病则仅在叶片上形成橙色夏孢子堆。  
## 防治措施  
应结合农业防治与化学防治，以减少病原菌侵染源。采收后应及时剪除并销毁结果枝，降低初侵染源。对感病性高且既往发生过该病的品种，应在病害症状及病原物征兆出现前，及时喷施保护性杀菌剂。  
## 有机认证作物适用方法  
采收后及时清除结果枝，并喷施石硫合剂或部分无机铜制剂，均为有机认证作物允许使用的防治措施。  
## 施药决策

[作物: caneberries] [病害: cane-and-leaf-rust]

## Management
Control is best achieved by using cultural methods to reduce pathogen sources in combination with fungicides. Remove and dispose of fruit canes soon after harvest to reduce inoculum sources. Highly susceptible varieties with a history of this disease should receive applications of protective fungicides before the onset of disease symptoms and pathogen signs.
## Organically Acceptable Methods
Removal of fruited canes after harvest and sprays of lime sulfur or some fixed coppers are acceptable management tools in an organically certified crop.

text:
［作物：浆果类藤本植物］［病害：枝孢菌果腐病］  
感染枝孢菌果腐病的黑莓和树莓果实表面覆盖一层天鹅绒状橄榄绿色菌丝体。该菌丝体虽外观不佳，但通常不会造成果实实质性损伤。枝孢菌（Cladosporium cladosporioides）可单独发生，也可与灰葡萄孢菌（Botrytis cinerea，即灰霉病病原菌）所致病斑共同发生。  
## 病害说明  
枝孢菌果腐病主要为浆果类藤本植物采后贮藏期病害。尽管该类真菌对果实实际危害较小，但其在果实表面形成的菌丝体严重影响商品外观，导致果实失去商品价值。该类真菌最适生长温度为20～25℃，但在常规果实贮藏的较低温度下亦可发生。
title: cladosporium-fruit-rot
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: cladosporium-fruit-rot]
Blackberry and raspberry plants with Cladosporium fruit rot have berries that are covered with a velvety, olive-green mycelial growth. While this growth is unsightly, it does not often damage the fruit. C. cladosporoides can occur alone or in association with lesions caused by Botrytis cinerea (the causal agent of Botrytis fruit rot).
## Comments on the Disease
Cladosporium fruit rot of caneberry is primarily a postharvest storage disease. Even though these fungi cause little actual damage to fruit, the mycelial growth on the fruit is unappealing, so the fruit is unmarketable. Optimal temperature for the growth of these fungi is between 68° to 77°F (20° to 25°C), but may occur at lower temperatures during normal fruit storage.

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：枝孢果腐病]  
该类真菌最适生长温度为20～25℃，但在果实正常贮藏的较低温度下亦可发生。  
该果腐病多发生在日灼或受其他方式损伤的果实上。  
## 防治措施  
加强田间卫生管理，合理调控园内湿度，以降低初侵染源数量及发病风险；定期、轻采，及时剔除损伤果和病果；果实采收后应尽快预冷至最适贮藏温度0℃。  
## 有机认证作物适用方法  
良好的田间卫生管理和规范采收操作，适用于有机认证作物。  
## 施药决策  
若天气条件有利于灰霉病菌和枝孢菌（如遇降雨）发生，则需施药防治。

This fruit rot is most commonly associated with fruit that is sunburned or damaged in some manner.
## Management
Practice good sanitation and manage moisture within the planting to reduce inoculum levels and the risk of infestation. Harvest regularly and carefully, removing damaged and infected fruit. Cool berries as rapidly as possible to an optimum of 32°F (0°C).
## Organically Acceptable Methods
Good sanitation and harvest practices are acceptable methods in an organically certified crop.
## Treatment Decisions
Treat if weather conditions are favorable for the development of Botrytis and Cladosporium fungi (i.e., rain).

[作物：黑莓、奥利莓] [病害：霜霉病]  
霜霉病初期在黑莓或奥利莓叶片正面呈现浅绿色至黄色褪绿斑，后期逐渐变为红色和紫色。成熟病斑多呈多角形，受叶脉限制。病斑背面（叶片反面）可见灰白色至灰褐色的霉层，但霉层常较稀疏，不易察觉。
title: downy-mildew
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: downy-mildew]
Downy mildew initially causes a light green to yellow discoloration on the upper blackberry or olallieberry leaf surface that eventually progresses to red and purple. Mature lesions are often angular and restricted by veins. White to gray spore masses also appear on the opposite side of lesions on the leaf underside, but they may be sparse and difficult to see.

text:
[作物：黑莓类浆果] [病害：霜霉病]  
叶背病斑对应位置也可见霉层，但往往稀疏，不易察觉。  
被霜霉病系统侵染的初生枝常表现为生长迟缓，向阳面枝条上出现红色条纹，顶叶呈红褐色。受霜霉病侵染的果实（干果）光泽暗淡、失水萎蔫，迅速干枯；幼果早期感病则提前变红、皱缩、变硬；生长后期果实感病则皱缩、干枯，并纵裂为两半。受侵染的果梗干枯、呈红色。
title: downy-mildew
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: downy-mildew]
e masses also appear on the opposite side of lesions on the leaf underside, but they may be sparse and difficult to see.
Primocanes systemically infected by downy mildew are often stunted and have red streaks on the side of the cane that faces the sun, with reddish colored terminal leaves. Downy mildew infected fruit (dry berry) is dull in luster, lacking in turgidity, and dries out rapidly. Early infection of green fruit induces premature reddening, shriveling, and hardening. Fruit infection later in the season causes shriveling, drying, and the fruit splitting into two parts. Downy mildew infected pedicels are dry and red.
## Comments on the Disease

text:
[作物：树莓类浆果] [病害：霜霉病]  
幼果染病后变硬、发红，果实纵裂为两半。染病花梗干枯、呈红色。  
## 病害发生特点  
霜霉病在气温18℃、多雨潮湿条件下最易流行。病原菌以菌丝体形式在植株根部、根茎部及枝条内越冬。孢子囊通常在近枝条处或植株基部的浓密叶丛中产生。冷凉、高湿的夜间利于空中孢子形成，并借风传播。侵染后10～11天即可显症。  
杂草丛生及枝叶郁闭造成田间湿度高，有利于病害在萌蘖枝上发生。  
## 防治措施
title: downy-mildew
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: downy-mildew]
ying, and the fruit splitting into two parts. Downy mildew infected pedicels are dry and red.
## Comments on the Disease
Downy mildew is most prevalent during wet weather at temperatures of 65°F (18°C). The pathogen overwinters as mycelium inside roots, crowns, and canes. Sporulation is usually found in dense foliage near the cane or at the base of the plant. Airborne spores are produced during cool, wet nights and are disseminated by wind. Symptoms develop within 10 to 11 days after infection.
Weed growth and dense canopies create humid environments that favor the development of the disease on suckers.
## Management

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：霜霉病]  
植株生长旺盛、冠层郁闭，易形成高湿环境，有利于霜霉病在萌蘖枝上发生发展。  
## 防治措施  
选用无病种苗。尽可能避免在曾发生过该病的地块种植。采用大拱棚栽培可显著抑制霜霉病发生，因棚内植株叶片及花器表面几乎无自由水存在。  
清除近邻种植区的替代寄主，如蔷薇属植物或野生黑莓等。定植成园后，及时抹除萌蘖枝、铲除杂草，以降低植株基部湿度；采收后及时剪除并销毁结果老枝。通过修剪调控篱架内湿度，是防控霜霉病的关键措施之一。  
## 有机认证允许使用的防治方法
title: downy-mildew
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: downy-mildew]
 growth and dense canopies create humid environments that favor the development of the disease on suckers.
## Management
Use pathogen-free planting stocks. If possible, avoid planting in sites with a history of this disease. The use of macrotunnels is very limiting to downy mildew infestation, because of the near total lack of free moisture on the leaves and flowers of the plants.
Destroy alternate hosts, such as rose or wild blackberries, that are in close proximity to a planting. Once the planting is established, remove suckers and weeds to reduce humidity at the base of the plant. Remove and destroy old fruiting canes after harvest. Reducing moisture in the hedgerow by pruning can be key in managing downy mildew.
## Organically Acceptable Methods

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：霜霉病]  
估算：通过修剪降低篱架区湿度，是防控霜霉病的关键措施。  
## 有机认证允许的防治方法  
使用无病种苗、科学选址、合理修剪、保持篱架区干燥，以及部分铜制剂喷雾，均适用于有机认证农产品。  
## 防治决策  
春季可喷施杀菌剂，保护黑莓叶片、花器及幼果免受侵染。

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：晚叶锈病]  
晚叶锈病侵染红树莓和紫树莓，属非系统性病原菌。顾名思义，晚叶锈病多在生长后期（自7月起）发生，初期在树莓植株中下部较老叶片上出现大量小型锈斑，斑点初呈黄色，后转为褐色。严重时可导致植株早期落叶，锈病亦可侵染花器及果实。叶片背面形成黄色夏孢子堆，其上产生粉状夏孢子；秋季，原有夏孢子堆内出现褐色冬孢子堆及冬孢子。
title: late-leaf-rust
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: late-leaf-rust]
Late leaf rust infects red and purple raspberry and is not a systemic pathogen. As the name late leaf rust suggests, later in the season (beginning in July) many small rust spots are found on the older, lower leaves of raspberries. These spots first turn yellow and then brown. In severe cases plants can be defoliated, and the rust can also infect flowers and fruit. Yellow uredinia and powdery urediniospores form on the bottom sides of leaves. In fall, telia and teliospores appear as brown growth within existing uredinia.
## Comments on the Disease

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：叶锈病]  
叶片背面出现橙黄色粉状夏孢子堆，后期病斑扩大并变褐。秋季，在原有夏孢子堆内形成褐色冬孢子堆及冬孢子。  
## 病害说明  
该病菌的转主寄主为白云杉（Picea glauca），但在树莓主产区——美国加州沿海地区并不常见，因此病菌很可能以菌丝体形式在残留枝条中越冬，并于翌年春季产生夏孢子，侵染新生植株。美洲柄锈菌（P. americanum）的孢子靠气流传播，高相对湿度有利于叶片侵染。  
## 防治
title: late-leaf-rust
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: late-leaf-rust]
es of leaves. In fall, telia and teliospores appear as brown growth within existing uredinia.
## Comments on the Disease
Because this pathogen's alternate host, white spruce (Picea glauca) , is not common in coastal California where caneberries are cultivated, the fungus probably overwinters as mycelium within remaining canes and produces urediniospores in spring. These spring urediniospores then infect growing plants. Spores of P. americanum are spread by wind, and infection of leaves is favored by high relative humidity.
## Management

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：晚叶锈病]  
美洲柄锈菌（P. americanum）孢子借风传播，叶片感病易发生在相对湿度较高的条件下。  
## 防治措施  
与黄锈病类似，任何可改善树莓篱壁内通风条件的措施均有助于抑制该病害的传播与发生。此外，及时清除染病的花枝（二年生枝）和营养枝（当年生枝），可有效减少初侵染源。在大型防雨棚（macrotunnel）内，干燥环境可显著抑制晚叶锈病的发生，但需在发病适期开始前完成棚体搭建；在蒙特雷湾地区，通常指7月中旬至下旬。

title: late-leaf-rust
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: late-leaf-rust]
 Spores of P. americanum are spread by wind, and infection of leaves is favored by high relative humidity.
## Management
As with yellow rust, any method that improves air circulation in the raspberry hedgerow is helpful in mitigating the spread and development of this disease. Also, the removal of infected floricanes and primocanes is useful in that it removes an important source of inoculum. The dry conditions in a macrotunnel greatly limit the infestation of late leaf rust, provided the tunnels are constructed before ideal conditions for infestation begin. In the Monterey Bay area, this generally means mid- to late July.

[作物：黑莓等蔓生浆果类] [病害：叶斑病]  
叶斑病可危害黑莓的叶片和枝条。叶片病斑近圆形，常具褐色或紫色边缘，中央呈灰白色；病斑直径约3～4毫米。枝条及叶柄上的病斑与叶片上相似，但多呈长椭圆形。成熟病斑的灰白区域可见散生的小型黑色分生孢子器（即链格孢属无性阶段的子实体）。该病症状多在生长季后期显现，但整个生长季内可多次发生侵染。
title: leaf-spot
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: leaf-spot]
Leaf spot can cause symptoms on leaves and canes of blackberries. Leaf lesions are somewhat circular in shape, often having a brown or purple margin, and typically have a whitish center. Leaf spots are about 0.12 to 0.16 inch (3–4 mm) in diameter. Lesions on canes and petioles are similar to those on leaves but more elongate. Small, black pycnidia (fungus fruiting bodies of the Septoria stage) can be seen in the whitened area of the mature lesions. Symptoms appear late in the season although infection can occur multiple times throughout the season.
## Comments on the Disease

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：叶斑病]

## 病害说明  
叶斑病发生于直立型和匍匐型黑莓、露莓、奥利莓及波森莓。分生孢子依靠风力和雨水飞溅在整个生长期传播，降雨增多会加重侵染。长期以来，该病原菌曾被认为与引起树莓叶斑病的病原菌相同；现已明确，导致浆果类藤本植物叶斑病的病原菌为 Rubi 壳二孢（有性态：小球腔菌属 Rubi，Mycosphaerella rubi；无性态：Rubus 属壳二孢 Septoria rubi），不侵染树莓。而树莓叶斑病则由树莓小球腔菌（有性态：Sphaerulina rubi；无性态：树莓柱隔孢 Cylindrosporium rubi）引起，在加州并不常见。尽管如此，两种病害的防治方法基本相同。  
## 防治

## Comments on the Disease
Leaf spot is found on erect and trailing blackberry, dewberry, olallieberry, and boysenberry. Conidia are disseminated by wind and water splash throughout the growing season, and infection increases with increased rainfall. For many years this pathogen was thought to be the same as the one that causes raspberry leaf spot on raspberry. It is now clear that the causal agent for leaf spot, Mycosphaerella rubi (anamorph Septoria rubi), does not infect raspberry. Raspberry leaf spot is caused by the pathogen Sphaerulina rubi (anamorph Cylindrosporium rubi) and is not common in California. The methods of control for the two diseases are very similar, however.

## 防治措施  
生长期叶斑病防控的关键在于改善园内及行内的通风条件，具体包括合理密植、疏枝以维持适宜的枝条密度、保持窄行距等措施。这些措施可降低冠层湿度，加快叶片和枝条表面水分蒸发，从而减少侵染机会。最重要的防控手段是在休眠期喷施石灰硫磺合剂，以清除老病斑、减少病原菌孢子产生。  
采用大拱棚栽培可显著抑制叶斑病发生，因其几乎完全避免了植株叶片和花器表面自由水的滞留。

## Management
The key to managing leaf spot during the growing season is to increase air circulation within the planting and the row. This includes such practices as proper spacing, thinning to maintain proper cane density, and maintaining narrow rows. These practices lower canopy humidity and allow faster drying of foliage and canes, resulting in less infection. The most important management tool is dormant lime sulfur applications that serve to burn out old lesions and thus reduce sporulation.
The use of macrotunnels is very limiting to leaf spot infestations because of the near total lack of free moisture on the leaves and flowers of the plants.

## Organically Acceptable Methods
Practices that increase air circulation within the planting, pruning out infected canes, and treatments with a copper sulfate either alone or in combination with lime sulfur are acceptable for use in an organically certified crop. text:
［作物：浆果类藤本植物］［病害：橙锈病］  
新抽生的叶片通常矮化、畸形、黄化。远观植株呈枝叶稀疏、细弱徒长状。后期，感病叶片背面出现不规则形状、蜡质状橙色性孢子器，随后破裂散出孢子，变为粉状鲜橙色。生长季后期，下部叶背面将产生褐色至黑褐色的冬孢子堆。典型症状还包括植株基部萌发大量细弱短小的萌蘖枝，此类枝条通常不能结果。
title: orange-rust
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: orange-rust]
Newly emerging leaves are usually stunted, deformed, and yellowish. From afar, the plant tends to have a lightly foliated, spindly appearance. Later, the undersides of diseased leaves exhibit irregularly shaped, waxy orange aecia that soon turn to a powdery bright orange as they rupture and release spores. Late in the season brown-black pustules of the teliospore stage will develop on lower leaf surfaces. A notable symptom is the growth many small, typically weak shoots from the base of the plant; such shoots are not usually productive.
## Comments on the Disease

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：橙锈病]  
植株基部常萌发细弱枝条，此类枝条通常不结果。  
## 病害说明  
橙锈病菌依据孢子形态差异及生活史长短（长生活史属Arthuriomyces，短生活史属Gymnoconia）加以区分。该病可侵染黑莓和黑树莓。橙锈病为系统性病害，病菌可侵入植株根茎部及根系，并终身寄生于植株体内。虽无直接致死记录，但病株严重衰弱，系统性侵染植株开花极少或完全不开花。  
## 防治
title: orange-rust
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: orange-rust]
ll, typically weak shoots from the base of the plant; such shoots are not usually productive.
## Comments on the Disease
Orange rust fungi are distinguished from each other by differences in spore appearance and by whether they have a long (Arthuriomyces) or short (Gymnoconia) life cycle. This disease can be found on blackberries and on black raspberries. Orange rust is systemic and, therefore, grows into plant crowns and roots and remains in the plant for life. Although this pathogen is not known to kill plants outright, it weakens them severely, and systemically infected plants produce few or no blossoms.
## Management

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：橙锈病]  
所有植株均被侵染，导致植株严重衰弱，系统性感染的植株开花极少甚至不开花。  
## 防治方法  
一旦确诊感染橙锈病，须立即拔除并清除田间病株，彻底销毁。拔除作业应在孢子产生和散播前完成。尽管该措施看似严厉，但为防止橙锈病进一步扩散，必须严格执行。最有效的防治措施是预防为主，从无病种苗入手，务必从信誉良好的正规苗圃采购无病种苗。

## Management
Once confirmed to be infected with orange rust, promptly uproot and remove diseased plants from the field and destroy them. Do this roguing before the production and release of spores. text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：疫霉根腐病]  
疫霉根腐病的田间症状首先表现为新抽生的一年生枝（初生枝）萎蔫，枝梢枯死。感病植株的二年生枝（结果枝）侧枝细弱。叶片自叶缘开始黄化或焦枯。常于当年首次高温天气期间出现严重萎蔫和枝条枯死。根系及根茎呈深褐色，须根缺失。若刮去近期萎蔫植株根茎或主根表层组织，可见红褐色病变组织，并在病健交界处形成明显分界线；随病组织腐烂，最终变为深褐色。
title: phytophthora-root-rot
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: phytophthora-root-rot]
Field symptoms of Phytophthora root rot are first noticed when new primocanes (first-year canes) wilt and the shoot tips die back. Floricanes (second-year canes) of affected plants have weak lateral shoots. Leaves turn yellow or scorch from the margins. Often severe wilt and dieback occur during the first hot spell of the season. Roots and crowns are dark brown in color and lack fibrous roots. If the outer surface is scraped from the crown or main roots of recently wilted plants a reddish brown color can be seen with a distinct line where infected and healthy tissues meet. Infected tissue will eventually turn dark brown as the tissue decays.
## Comments on the Disease

text:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: phytophthora-root-rot]
d healthy tissues meet. Infected tissue will eventually turn dark brown as the tissue decays.
## Comments on the Disease
Phytophthora is a soilborne pathogen that survives in the soil as a resting spore (oospore). When soils become saturated with water for prolonged periods, infectious motile spores (zoospores) are released into the soil and can infect raspberry roots or crowns. Phytophthora species other than P. fragariae var. rubi may be involved in root rot of raspberry. (Generally, Phytophthora does not cause economic damage to blackberries.) Not all root rots are due to Phytophthora. Raspberry roots are very sensitive to excessive moisture in the soil for long periods of time. Root death from lack of air can also occur and result in similar foliar and root decay symptoms.

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：疫霉根腐病]  
长期积水会导致根系缺氧死亡，进而引发与疫霉根腐病相似的地上部萎蔫和根系腐烂症状。  
## 防治措施  
最佳防治方法是选用无病土壤并确保良好排水条件进行定植。避免在易积水的低洼地或排水不良的黏重土壤上种植。采用高垄栽培和科学的灌溉管理可有效改善排水状况，从而降低发病几率和危害程度。应严格监控并精准调控灌溉水量。选用无病种苗，在无病土壤中定植，并选择适应当地环境、对根腐病抗性较强的品种。  
## 品种耐病性
title: phytophthora-root-rot
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: phytophthora-root-rot]
r long periods of time. Root death from lack of air can also occur and result in similar foliar and root decay symptoms.
## Management
Control is best achieved by planting in noninfested soils that have good drainage. Avoid low-lying areas that collect excessive water or clay soils that are poorly drained. The use of raised beds can improve drainage as can proper irrigation management; this in turn can reduce disease incidence and severity. Carefully monitor and control irrigation. Use clean plant stock, plant in noninfested soils, and use cultivars suitable for local conditions that are less susceptible to root rots.
## Variety Tolerance

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：疫霉根腐病]  
选择排水良好的土壤，并选用适应当地条件、对根腐病抗性较强的品种。  
## 品种耐病性  
多数黑莓品种对疫霉菌表现出高度耐病性，而红树莓总体上较感病；其中拉瑟姆（Latham）、基拉尼（Killarny）、卡罗琳（Caroline）和北欧（Nordic）等品种耐病性较强，而鲁比（Ruby）、遗产（Heritage）和波拉娜（Polana）等品种最易感病。  
## 有机认证作物适用方法  
合理选址、加强水分管理、使用无病种苗及选用适宜品种，均为有机认证作物中认可的防控措施。  
## 防治决策
title: phytophthora-root-rot
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: phytophthora-root-rot]

## Variety Tolerance
Many blackberry cultivars appear to be highly tolerant to Phytophthora, whereas red raspberries are in the main fairly susceptible, with the varieties Latham, Killarny, Caroline, and Nordic most tolerant and the varieties Ruby, Heritage, and Polana most susceptible.
## Organically Acceptable Methods
Proper site selection with good water management and the use of clean stock and appropriate cultivars are acceptable management tools in an organically certified crop.
## Treatment Decisions

text:
[作物：浆果类藤本植物] [病害：疫霉根腐病]  
选用抗病砧木和适宜品种，是有机认证作物中可接受的防控措施。  
## 防治决策  
定植前熏蒸处理可降低初始菌源量，有助于植株在严重感病地块成活建园，但病原菌会随时间推移重新定殖该区域。在结果期适时施用杀菌剂，亦可降低已建园地块的发病程度。

感病树莓叶片初期可见浅绿色（失绿）斑块；后期叶片及枝条表面覆盖白色至灰白色菌丝层。受害叶片常出现卷曲、扭曲或其他畸形；严重感病枝条细长徒长，叶片矮化并向上卷曲；重病植株生长受抑、矮小。  
## 病害发生特点  
在加州，白粉病菌以菌丝体形式在芽内或一年生枝（初生枝）表面越冬。生长季中，病组织表面大量产生分生孢子，作为再侵染源，在整个生育期反复侵染。该病菌孢子靠气流传播，温暖干燥天气有利于病害发生发展。  
## 防治
title: powdery-mildew
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: powdery-mildew]
Caneberry leaves infected with powdery mildew initially may develop light green (chlorotic) patches on leaves. Leaves and shoots later are covered with white to gray mycelial growth. Affected leaves may be curved, twisted, or otherwise distorted. Severely infected shoots become long and spindly with dwarf leaves that curl upward. Severely diseased plants may be stunted.
## Comments on the Disease
In California, the powdery mildew pathogen overwinters as mycelium in buds or on the surface of first-year canes (primocanes). Later, conidia are produced abundantly on the surface of infected tissue and serve as secondary inoculum for repeated cycles of infection throughout the growing season. The spores are airborne and the development of disease is favored by warm, dry weather.
## Management

## Management
Blackberries and varieties of red, black, and purple raspberries vary in their susceptibility to powdery mildew. Where powdery mildew is a serious problem, avoid planting highly susceptible cultivars. The blackberries from the Arkansas breeding program such as Navaho, Apache, and Arapaho tend to have very low susceptibility to powdery mildew as well as other diseases.

Practices that allow good air circulation and direct light penetration have been reported helpful in limiting the spread of the disease. These include proper plant spacing, cane thinning, and maintaining narrow rows. Removing late-forming suckers with powdery mildew symptoms and cutting back of floricanes (second-year canes) to a horticulturally desired height may reduce primary sources of inoculum.
Incidence and severity of powdery mildew tends to be higher in macrotunnels because the warm, dry conditions found inside the tunnels favor disease development. Free water is not necessary for the disease to develop, but higher humidity favors the disease.

## 害虫特征  
红莓螨是栽培和野生黑莓的常年性害虫，但对树莓不构成经济性危害。该螨属于瘿螨科（Eriophyidae）一类微小螨类，成螨具两对足，可用10～20倍手持放大镜观察，解剖显微镜下观察效果更佳；成螨呈蠕虫状，半透明白色。  
红莓螨以成螨在芽鳞内或芽内部越冬。春季枝条萌发生长时，螨迁移到新生枝上；花芽出现后，即钻入初展的花芽、花朵，并进一步侵入果实发育中的小核果（druplet），尤以果实基部及果核周围为甚。  
## 为害症状
title: redberry-mite
text_en:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: redberry-mite]
Description of the Pest
Damage
## Description of the Pest
The redberry mite is a perennial pest of both cultivated and wild blackberries but is not an economic pest of raspberries. These mites belong to a group of microscopic mites known as eriophyid mites. This eriophyid mite has two pairs of legs; it can be seen with a 10 to 20X hand lens but is best seen with a dissecting microscope. The adult is wormlike and translucent white.
Redberry mites overwinter in bud scales or deep in buds. As shoot growth develops in spring, the mites move onto the developing shoots. As flower buds appear, the mites work their way into the unfolding buds, into the flowers, and down among the developing drupelets of the berries, especially near the bases and around the core of the fruit.
## Damage

text:
[作物：树莓类] [病害：红莓螨]  
主要栖息于果实发育中的小核果内，尤以小核果基部及果核周围为多。  
## 危害  
受红莓螨为害的果实，其小核果不能正常着色。受害小核果通常质地坚硬，呈绿色或鲜红色，果实失去商品价值。部分受害果实可能仅部分小核果保持红色、坚硬，其余小核果则能正常成熟。若不加防治，红莓螨可于翌年从零星发生点扩散至大面积植株。种群数量极高时，可造成严重减产。该害虫对晚熟黑莓品种危害尤为严重。  
## 防治
title: redberry-mite

## Damage
Fruit infested with redberry mites do not develop normally colored drupelets. Affected drupelets usually remain hard and have a green or bright red color. The fruit is unmarketable. Fruit partially affected may have some drupelets remain red and hard with the remaining drupelets developing proper ripening. If not controlled, redberry mite can spread from isolated infestations to sizable portions of a planting in the next season. Very high populations can result in significant crop loss. The pest is most damaging to late-maturing blackberry cultivars.
## Management

## 石硫合剂  
石硫合剂的施用时期取决于树莓品种及红莓螨发生程度。对于冬季保持叶片的黑莓品种，应在芽萌动期开始施用石硫合剂，之后每3周施用1次，至采收前12天停止；对于冬季自然落叶的黑莓品种，应在芽解除休眠前施用石硫合剂，此后需待枝条长出完整叶幕并始花时再行施用。

## Lime Sulfur
Timing of lime sulfur applications depends upon variety grown and redberry mite severity. For blackberry varieties that retain a leaf canopy through the winter, begin lime sulfur applications at bud break and continue at 3-week intervals up to 12 days before the start of harvest. For blackberry varieties that naturally defoliate over the winter, apply lime sulfur before buds break dormancy and then not again until canes have a full leaf canopy and first bloom appears.
## Horticultural Oils

## 园艺矿物油

Horticultural oils, such as Golden Pest Spray Oil, when used at the rate of 1.2 to 2% volume to volume, applied after green fruit or first pink fruit stage in four consecutive applications spaced 2 or 3 weeks apart give significant control of redberry mite, while causing less harm to fruit yield than sulfur sprays.

## 害虫特征  
斑翅果蝇近年已在加利福尼亚州多个县发现，危害即将成熟的樱桃、 raspberry（树莓）、blackberry（黑莓）、blueberry（蓝莓）和strawberry（草莓）等作物；亦见其危害boysenberry（波森莓）、部分日本李、李杏杂交种（plumcots）及油桃等其他软质果肉果实。成虫与幼虫外形与常见醋蝇（黑腹果蝇，Drosophila melanogaster）及其他主要取食腐烂或发酵果实的果蝇属（Drosophila）种类极为相似。但斑翅果蝇可直接产卵于完好无损的健康果实内，造成严重危害。

## Description of the Pest
Spotted-wing drosophila has recently been found in many California counties infesting ripening cherry , raspberry, blackberry, blueberry, and strawberry crops; it has also been observed attacking other soft-flesh fruit such as boysenberry, varieties of Japanese plums, plumcots, and nectarines. Adults and maggots closely resemble the common vinegar fly, Drosophila melanogaster, and other Drosophila species that primarily attack rotting or fermenting fruit. The spotted-wing drosophila, however, readily attacks undamaged fruit.

Adults are small (2-3 mm) flies with red eyes and a pale brown thorax. The abdomen has black stripes. The most distinguishable trait of the adult is that the males have a black spot towards the tip of each wing. Larvae are tiny (up to 3.5 mm), white cylindrical maggots that are found feeding in fruit. One to many larvae may be found feeding within a single fruit. After maturing, the larvae partially or completely exit the fruit to pupate.

## Damage
Unlike other vinegar flies that occur in California, spotted-wing drosophila attacks healthy ripening fruit as well as damaged or rotting fruit. ## Attractant Bait Sprays and Pesticides
Attractant-based bait sprays targeting adult flies such as GF-120 (bait plus insecticide) can be applied. Because it is a bait, coverage is not as important as keeping the bait attractive. Applications made at low volumes and with large droplet size across the production field or orchard and border areas can be useful in reducing fly populations while minimizing effects on predators, parasites, and honeybees. However, because the efficacy of any bait and toxicant decreases over time, this material need to be re-applied, perhaps at weekly or bi-weekly intervals to be effective. Traps will need to be monitored to assure that adult fly suppression has been achieved. Heavy fly infestations may require more frequent applications because the bait may be consumed faster than with lower populations.

## Description of the Pest
Twospotted spider mites infest the undersides of caneberry leaves, where they may form colonies and produce light webbing when abundant. Twospotted spider mites are very small (about 0.02 inch in length) and are barely visible to the naked eye. Nymphs , adult males, and reproductive females are green to a yellowish hue in color. Reproductively dormant females are bright orange and should not be confused with the predatory mite, Phytoseiulus persimilis, commonly found in mite colonies. Under a hand lens, one can see two dark blotches on either side of the adult twospotted spider mite's body and two red eyespots on the head.

In areas where temperatures are cold in winter, twospotted spider mites overwinter as dormant adult females at the base of the caneberries or weeds in and around the field. With the onset of warm weather, these mites migrate to the foliage of the plant and begin to lay eggs. In the mild winter coastal-growing regions of California, it is unusual for a large percentage of mites to become dormant; instead they continue to grow and lay eggs , although at a slower pace during the winter months than in summer. The twospotted spider mite undergoes one larval and two nymphal stages before becoming an adult. The life cycle, under ideal conditions of hot, dry weather, can take place in 10 days.

## Damage
Spider mites feed by sucking juices from the plant and cause a gray stippling on the leaf surface. As the population grows and feeding progresses, leaves turn yellowish brown before drying up and falling off. Feeding by twospotted spider mites on fruiting floricanes reduces plant vigor and fruit yield and size. Mite feeding can also weaken primocanes, predisposing them to winter injury in areas of cold winters and reducing yield the following season.

## Management
Twospotted spider mites can be a problem in any caneberry planting if condition are conducive to their development, but they pose a special problem in plantings that use macrotunnels because of the hot, dry conditions that are created by the tunnels. The key to successful management of twospotted spider mites is to monitor populations and to initiate control measures in a timely manner. Once populations are large, much damage has been done, and the mite populations are difficult to control.
## Biological Control

## Biological Control
The most effective biological control agent of twospotted mite is the predatory mite Phytoseiulus persimilis , which is an introduced species. Phytoseiulus does best in temperatures of 60° to 80°F and will not do well above 100°F. Because the temperatures in macrotunnels are generally higher than outside, P. persimilis does not perform as well inside of the tunnels. This predatory mite has apparently established itself in some locations and provides some natural suppression in these areas. It may also be purchased and released in fields for additional control.

## Cultural Control
Normal pruning of primocanes and removal of dead floricanes in caneberries can be helpful in reducing the buildup of twospotted spider mite. Varieties with heavily pubescent leaves can make establishment difficult for twospotted spider mites and may be useful for those situations where twospotted mites are a significant problem. Because the warm, dry conditions within a macrotunnel are very conducive to the population growth of twospotted spider mites, limiting the use of tunnels or venting them to maintain a lower temperature will limit the numbers of this pest mite. Also, controlling dust by watering or oiling surrounding roads is an important factor in limiting twospotted spider mite populations.

目前尚未为浆果类藤本植物上的二斑叶螨制定明确的防治阈值。应持续开展监测，掌握害螨种群数量上升趋势及捕食性螨类种群动态。当捕食性螨与二斑叶螨的数量比达到1∶10时，可视为生物防治效果良好的标志。采用化学药剂防治时，务必确保喷雾均匀、全面覆盖；尤其在使用矿物油类药剂时，若叶螨未直接接触药液，则可能存活。

## Monitoring and Treatment Decisions
No precise treatment thresholds have been established for twospotted mites in caneberries. Monitor to keep track of increasing pest mite populations as well as predatory mite populations. A ratio of 1 predator to 10 twospotted mites is considered favorable for biological control. When using chemical controls, it is important to know that good coverage is essential. In many cases, especially with the spray oils, mites that escape contact with the control material will survive.

Leaves on plants infected with Verticillium wilt turn yellow, wither, and fall, beginning at the base of canes and progressing upward. Fruiting canes may take on a bluish black cast and die during summer as fruit are maturing. Symptoms sometimes appear first on only one side of the plant while the opposite side remains healthy before also becoming infected. Vascular discoloration, which is typical of Verticillium wilt for many crops, can be slight or absent for raspberries. Small groups of plants throughout the field may be affected. Primocanes (current season's growth) are usually free of the disease; however, a severe infection in newly planted fields may kill the plants the first year.

text:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: verticillium-wilt]
# Comments on the Disease
In California, Verticillium is only rarely found on raspberries and sometimes on blackberries.
The fungus persists in the soil in an actively growing state when susceptible crops or weeds are present or otherwise as dormant resting structures (microsclerotia). It often occurs in soil that was formerly planted to tomatoes, potatoes, strawberries, cotton, eggplants, peppers, cucurbits, and many other plants. Infection occurs when roots come into contact with the microsclerotia. The disease is favored by cool weather and can infect through either healthy or wounded roots and root hairs. After the initial infection, the fungus grows into the water-conducting tissues of the root (xylem) and spreads upward into the cane xylem. Eventually, the xylem tissues become plugged by the growth of the fungus or by the plant's internal defense mechanisms, such as the deposition of gums or the development of tyloses (overgrowths of parenchyma cells that are adjacent to xylem vessels), and the canes wilt and die. The fungus is then returned to the soil as the dead roots decompose and microsclerotia become available to infect new plants.

## Management
Verticillium wilt can be a difficult disease to manage. Avoid planting in fields that have a recent crop history of highly susceptible plants such as vegetable crops; such fields possibly contain high levels of the Verticillium microsclerotia. Fields that have been infested with weeds such as pigweed, nightshade, and lambsquarters can also contain high levels of the fungus. Select fields that are not infested and use clean planting stock.

text:
[作物: caneberries] [病害: yellow-rust]
Of the major caneberry crops, yellow rust infects only red raspberry and is not a systemic pathogen, meaning the pathogen does not spread internally through the plant. In spring, yellowish orange pustules (aecia) form on the tops of raspberry leaves close to the ground. Early season observation of aecia on the tops of leaves is a general way to distinguish this rust from late leaf rust, which also infects red raspberry.

Severely affected leaves can dry out and die. Later in June and July, orange to yellow pustules (uredinia) appear on the undersides of leaves; these structures later darken as black teliospores develop from the middle of July to fall. The yellow rust fungus overwinters as teliospores on the bark of remaining floricanes (fruiting canes). Such canes are the sources of inoculum that affect emerging leaves and primocanes (vegetative canes) the following spring.
## Management

## Management
If possible and horticulturally sensible, complete removal of floricane and first flush of primocane is useful in controlling this disease, because it removes most sources of inoculum. Any method of pruning that improves air circulation is helpful in reducing yellow rust, as this allows leaves, flowers, and fruit to dry more quickly, subsequently reducing plant susceptibility. The dry conditions in a macrotunnel greatly limit the infestation of yellow rust, provided the tunnels are constructed before ideal conditions for infestation begin. In the Monterey Bay area, this generally means mid- to late July.
## Organically Acceptable Methods

Treatment for all occurrences of yellow rust are not necessary because it has been shown that light-to-moderate infections of yellow rust do not affect raspberry plant productivity. Fungicide treatments should be made with an eye to preventing large outbreaks, rather than eliminating the disease. Thus, low levels of disease late in season probably do not merit treatment, while it might be recommended to apply fungicide if signs of yellow rust are seen early in the season, for example in June.

Roots infected with Armillaria mellea have white to yellowish fan-shaped mycelial mats between the bark and the wood. Dark brown to black rhizomorphs sometimes can be seen on the root surface. All stone fruit rootstocks are susceptible to Armillaria root rot.
## Comments on the Disease
The fungus survives on dead roots.
## Management
Generally, once a cherry tree trunk becomes infected with Armillaria mellea, it cannot be saved and should be removed.

## Preparation and Timing for Treatment
Before planting or replanting an orchard site, remove all infected trees, stumps, and as many roots greater than 1 inch in diameter as possible. Healthy-appearing trees adjacent to those showing symptoms are often infected also. Removal of these adjacent trees and inclusion of that ground in the soil fumigation may be advisable. Infected trees, stumps, and roots should be burned at the site or disposed of in areas where flood waters cannot wash them to agricultural lands. Complete eradication is rarely achieved, and re-treatment may be necessary in localized areas. If the soil is wet or if it has extensive clay layers to the depths reached by the roots, fumigant treatment may not be successful. The greatest opportunity for eradication occurs on shallow soils less than 5 feet in depth. Treat Armillaria from late summer to early fall.

Symptoms are most obvious in spring, and include limb dieback with rough cankers and amber-colored gum. There may also be leaf spot and blast of young flowers and shoots .
